heads.t: 黃仁勳下台機率飆88%！「2大內部人選」接班呼聲高 輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳近期因婚外情爭議及美國國會對國安議題關注，導致其領導地位出現動搖。根據預測市場Polymarket數據，黃仁勳於年底前下台機率已飆升至88％，輝達董事會也傳出正積極評估替代人選。外界討論接班焦點包括內部的伊恩巴克（Ian Buck）與柯蕾特克雷斯（Colette Kress），甚至剛卸任蘋果執行長的提姆庫克（Tim Cook）也被列入可能名單。未來黃仁勳若卸任，市場關注輝達AI霸主地位是否會受影響，接班人選及公司治理成為投資人與業界高度關注的焦點。 11 分鐘前｜財經…

heads.t: 吃老四川火鍋自備蟑螂腳！ 奧客拚免單還討紅包被起訴了 高雄一名48歲伍姓男子，6月中旬至知名的連鎖火鍋老四川高雄中山店用餐，竟自備蟑螂腳放入冰淇淋中，謊稱吃到異物，不僅想免費吃霸王餐，還企圖向店家索取慰問金。整個過程被店內監視器完整拍下，店家報警提告，男子現已遭高雄地檢署依詐欺罪提起公訴。 3 分鐘前｜社會 吃老四川火鍋自備蟑螂腳！ 奧客拚免單還討紅包被起訴了 3 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: Old Sichuan Hotpot prepared its own cockroaches! The Austrians were accused of having a red bag, a 48-year-old man who ate in mid-June at a famous chained hotpot, Sichuan Takashi Nakayama's shop, put his own cockroach feet in ice cream, falsely claimed to have eaten alien food, not only to eat the king's meal free of charge, but also to ask the store for consolation money. The entire process was filmed by the insider of the store, who reported to the police that the man had now been charged with fraud by the Takashi District Attorney's Office. 3 minutes ago, the society ate the old Sichuan fire pot to prepare its feet!

heads.t: 凌晨領包裹騎電車突失控 高雄14歲少年「撞破超商」嚇壞顧客 高雄市楠梓區一名14歲少年，於今（12）日凌晨騎乘電動輔助自行車行經惠心路時，疑似因煞車突然失靈，整輛車失控衝向路旁騎樓，直接撞破連鎖超商的大門，現場玻璃碎裂一地、聲響驚人。所幸事故僅造成少年手腳輕微擦傷，超商內部店員與顧客也均未受傷，目前少年家長事後已出面與業者協調後續賠償修繕事宜。 4 分鐘前｜社會 凌晨領包裹騎電車突失控 高雄14歲少年「撞破超商」嚇壞顧客 4 分鐘前｜社會

羅大佑喊「外省人被欺負夠慘」！梁文傑曝自己是外省人：聽不懂他講啥 資深音樂人羅大佑日前接受廣播節目專訪時，批評民進黨過去爭取言論自由，如今卻讓民眾不敢發聲，更直言「現在外省人被欺負得夠慘了」，引發爭議。陸委會副主委梁文傑今日表示，這樣講是對社會造成一個很大的分裂，自己身為外省人，「我完全聽不懂羅大佑在講什麼」，因為羅大佑本身不是外省人，也不用去幫外省人去多費心了。 9 分鐘前｜政治 羅大佑喊「外省人被欺負夠慘」！梁文傑曝自己是外省人：聽不懂他講啥 9 分鐘前｜政治
heads.en: Ro Dae-woo says, "It's bad for the outsiders!" Liang Wenjie is a foreigner: when he was interviewed on the radio by a highly qualified musician, Luo Daewoo, he criticized the party’s past struggle for freedom of speech, which now discourages people from speaking out, more frankly, that “the foreigners are being bullied enough” to cause controversy. Liang Wenjie, Vice-Chairman of the Commission, said today that this is a huge division of society, that he is a foreigner and that "I have no idea what he is talking about" because he is not a foreigner himself, and that he does not have to help them. 9 minutes ago, Luo Dae-woo shouted, "It's bad for the outsiders!" Liang Wenjie exposed himself to being a foreigner: I don't know what he said.

heads.t: 女看護控遭運將「枕頭悶臉」性侵！全程僅23分鐘 這原因敗訴 高雄市一名印尼籍女看護，在2022年期間透過交友軟體結識了蕭姓計程車司機，兩人相約前往高雄大社區某汽車旅館後，女看護卻將蕭男一狀告上法院，控訴遭「枕頭悶臉」性侵，提告求償精神慰撫金50萬元。不過案件經過橋頭地方法院簡易庭審理後卻大逆轉，法官查出兩人駕車進房到離開「全程僅短短23分鐘」，且女方身上未檢出任何男性DNA，供詞更是前後矛盾，最終裁定駁回民事求償，全案仍可上訴。 15 分鐘前｜社會 女看護控遭運將「枕頭悶臉」性侵！全程僅23分鐘 這原因敗訴 15 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: Women's escorts have been sexually assaulted by the "sniffing face" for only 23 minutes. This was the reason for the failure of a Indonesian nurse in Takahsiung City who, in 2022, had met with friends and found a taxi driver, and after they went to a motel in Takahsiung's community, the nurse brought a case against Xiao Man in court, accusing him of "snocking face" and demanding half a million dollars for emotional comfort. However, the case turned upside down after a simple trial by the District Court on the bridge, where the judge found that the two men had driven into the house and left the house "just 23 minutes short" and that the woman had not recovered any male DNA, and that the statement was more contradictory, and that the case was still pending. 15 minutes ago, the women's escort was sexually abused by the "margins"! It's only 23 minutes away.

AI商機帶旺！台灣大哥大第三季賺42.6億 企業電信營收大增34% 台灣大哥大今（12）日召開法說會，公布2026年第三季營運報告，電信本業、企業服務、科技事業三大成長引擎同步發揮，單季稅後淨利年增18%，每股盈餘達1.4元。其中，企業電信服務成為最大亮點，資料中心、AI資通訊及資安服務營收全面成長。而台灣大哥大也已完成公開收購精誠資訊一案，持股比率提升至61.02%，進一步擴大市場布局。 11 分鐘前｜財經 AI商機帶旺！台灣大哥大第三季賺42.6億 企業電信營收大增34% 11 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: In the third season of the Taiwan Big Brother's third season, a 34 per cent increase in the company's telecommunications industry has been observed, and the Taiwan Big Brother (12) has called for the launch of the third quarter of 2026, with the simultaneous launch of three long engines of telecom, corporate services, and science and technology, with a net annual increase of 18 per cent and a surplus of $1.4 per share after a single season tax. In this case, the corporate telecom service became the biggest highlight, and the data centre, AI Communication and Security Services (AIS) fully grew. In the case of Taiwan's Big Brother, who has completed the public procurement of accurate information, the shareholding ratio has risen to 61.02 per cent, further expanding the market landscape. 11 minutes ago, the capital of Tai Wan made $4.26 billion in the third season, and the company's telecommunications company increased 34%, 11 minutes ago.

heads.en: It's only 8 o'clock! The Temple will be angry with the police for having been exposed to a gun.
